searches.reason: Replace uncalibrated sensitivity scores with probes whose expected behavior is known. Seek inexpensive controlled faults—disabled history attention, shuffled position embeddings, popularity-only scoring—and test whether diagnostics distinguish them from the intact model. Connect detected signatures to specific components without interpreting sensitivity as causal preference or validation accuracy.

searches.reason: Address qualitative complaints about broad associations and redundant recommendations using available titles, descriptions, and histories. Seek evidence-grounded taxonomies that distinguish explicit textual contradictions, near-duplicate exposure, weak task support, and insufficient information. Require abstention for unknown ownership or compatibility and assess annotation agreement before trusting automated measurements; exclude unavailable reviews, traits, and external pretrained weights.

searches.reason: Challenge whether strong in-sample margins against easy negatives diagnose useful ranking behavior. Seek training-only audits with fixed uniform, popularity-matched, and lexical hard candidates, followed by bounded full-catalog comparisons. Measure rank stability and failure concentration by history length and item frequency across all four datasets; keep these audits separate from the unchanged host macro validation HR@10 used for selection.
